### 1 — Scene
A plated meal of seasoned chicken strips and rice, with leafy salad, avocado, a corn-on-the-cob slice, and a little broccoli.

### 2 — Vessel
A large, roughly square dinner plate, partly cropped. Using a **26 cm equivalent diameter**, its estimated area is **3.14 × 13² = 531 cm²**.

### 3 — Items
Visible foods: chicken, seasoned rice, spinach/mixed leaves, avocado, corn, broccoli, and a few tomato/onion pieces. No separate pool of sauce or dressing is apparent; estimated cooking fat is included in the chicken and rice energy values.

### 4–7 — Area, volume, weight, and energy
Area shares are approximate, with overlapping foods assigned separate shares to avoid double-counting.

| Item | Plate area | Area × height = gross volume | Density | Weight | kcal/100 g | kcal |
|---|---:|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Seasoned chicken | 18% | 96 cm² × 1.3 cm = 125 ml | 0.95 | 119 g | 190 | 226 |
| Seasoned rice | 17% | 90 cm² × 1.8 cm = 162 ml | 0.80 | 130 g | 160 | 208 |
| Leafy greens | 25% | 133 cm² × 2 cm = 266 ml | 0.13 | 35 g | 23 | 8 |
| Avocado | 5% | 27 cm² × 1.2 cm = 32 ml | 0.65 | 21 g | 160 | 34 |
| Corn slice, edible kernels | 7% | 37 cm² × 2 cm = 74 ml | 0.55* | 41 g | 96 | 39 |
| Broccoli | 2% | 11 cm² × 2 cm = 22 ml | 0.50 | 11 g | 35 | 4 |
| Tomato/onion pieces | 2% | 11 cm² × 0.8 cm = 9 ml | 0.60 | 5 g | 30 | 2 |

*Corn density expresses edible kernel mass per gross slice volume, excluding the inedible cob.*

### 8 — Sanity check
The area shares total **76%**, consistent with the substantial empty portion of the plate. Estimated edible food totals **362 g and 521 kcal**—plausible for the visible chicken-and-rice portion with light vegetables. Cropping and uncertain food depth make this approximate.
